page_title: WOL 0-2 CRY | Wolves v Crystal Palace 22/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' Jackson Tchatchoua (Wolves) whips the ball into the box and Jorgen Strand Larsen takes a perfect touch to control it, but one of the defenders does well to intercept.
90+2' Substitution. Adam Wharton did his best and is replaced by Will Hughes (Crystal Palace).
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Anthony Taylor interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace).
89' The current number of offsides is 2:3.

89' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass. Golden chance! Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the right post.
88' It will be a substitution. Hugo Bueno (Wolves) is ready to enter the pitch as David Moller Wolfe walks off.
88' Referee Anthony Taylor signals NO PENALTY for Crystal Palace after a VAR review!

87' Play continues despite the shouts by some Crystal Palace players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Anthony Taylor interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
87' Toti (Wolves) brings his opponent down. Anthony Taylor has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Crystal Palace earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
84' Andre (Wolves) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play.

84' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle after Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Free kick. Wolves will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jaydee Canvot is coming onto the pitch as Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) cannot continue after picking up an injury.
82' Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
81' Oliver Glasner prepares a substitution. Yeremy Pino is replaced by Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace).
81' Substitution. Daichi Kamada leaves the pitch and is replaced by Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace).
80' What a chance! Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) gets on the end of a pass inside the box and takes a shot to the bottom right corner, but one of the defending players makes a crucial goal-line clearance.
77' The ball is laid off to Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the bottom right corner and forces Sam Johnstone to make a decent save.
77' Joao Gomes (Wolves) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!
76' A precise short pass from David Moller Wolfe releases Jhon Arias (Wolves) in space inside the box, but he smashes a wild shot well past the left post.
75' Rob Edwards has decided to substitute Ladislav Krejci and he is replaced by Jhon Arias (Wolves).
74' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
71' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Jorgen Strand Larsen. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.

69' 0 - 2 Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) controls the ball on the edge of the box after a superb low pass by Adam Wharton. He makes a yard for himself and fires a wonderful strike into the roof of the net via the underside of the bar. 0:2!
68' 6:6 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The current number of shots on goal is 1:2.
67' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
66' Rob Edwards has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) replacing Marshall Munetsi.
66' Substitution. Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare will be replaced by Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves).
66' The referee is firm and issues Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) a deserved yellow card.
66' No offside! Referee Anthony Taylor points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Crystal Palace players celebrate.
64' The Crystal Palace players halt their celebrations as referee Anthony Taylor makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

63' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Adam Wharton has a shot blocked, but the ball falls to Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) who finds some space inside the box and lashes the ball into the top of the net. The score is 0:1.
63' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) works the corner short.
62' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Now Crystal Palace have a corner.
61' Dangerous play by Toti (Wolves). Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul.
60' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) will replace Jean-Philippe Mateta.
59' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) receives a yellow card for infringement.
58' The ball finds it way to Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) inside the box and his first-time shot flies just over the bar.

56' Jackson Tchatchoua almost found himself in a promising position after Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) tried to send a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defenders reacts well and makes a timely interception.
54' Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) sends a long ball forward to Yeremy Pino, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
53' Anthony Taylor couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves) and blew his whistle.
52' Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
50' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves) was quite harsh and Anthony Taylor didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
49' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) is caught offside once again.
48' Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) picks up a lucky rebound inside the box from the clearance, beats an opponent but drills his shot inches over the bar.
48' The resulting corner, taken by Andre (Wolves), comes to nothing.
48' David Moller Wolfe (Wolves) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. Good work from Wolves as they win a corner.
47' Jackson Tchatchoua (Wolves) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
47' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) produces a cross from the resulting free kick from just outside the box, but the goalkeeper smothers the ball.
46' Toti (Wolves) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. That's a free kick to Crystal Palace.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Sam Johnstone, who smothers the ball.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
44' Wonderful pass from Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) for Jorgen Strand Larsen, but they can't profit from it as Dean Henderson comes off his line to collect.
42' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) tries to find Tyrick Mitchell, but he puts too much power on the pass.
41' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

40' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee points to the corner flag and Crystal Palace will take a corner.
37' Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) was too forceful with his tackle and Anthony Taylor interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
34' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
33' The total number of attempts is 3:3. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 1:1.
32' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
31' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Crystal Palace earn a corner.
28' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) is penalised for a foul. Anthony Taylor had a clear view and blows his whistle.
27' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.

26' Joao Gomes (Wolves) has the opportunity to threaten the opponent's goal via a free kick on the edge of the box. He hits a fine strike towards the bottom right corner, but Dean Henderson denies him with a great save. Ladislav Krejci (Wolves) misses a rebound from close range. His effort floats narrowly over the crossbar!
24' Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Anthony Taylor blows for a foul. Wolves have a free kick from a promising distance.
21' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

21' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) gets on the end of a pass and produces a promising first-time shot towards the left side of the goal. His effort is blocked by Sam Johnstone with a brilliant diving save! The ball goes behind for a corner. Crystal Palace will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

19' The cross into the penalty area from Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.

18' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
18' Poor challenge! Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) is penalised for tripping and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Crystal Palace.
16' Yeremy Pino provides the assist in the box, but Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) places his shot a fraction wide of the right post.
16' 41:59 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
15' Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
14' A free kick into the box, taken by Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace), is comfortably cleared by the opposition's defence.
13' NO PENALTY after a VAR review! The Crystal Palace players are visibly unhappy with the call. Crystal Palace are awarded a free kick on the edge of the box.
12' Referee Anthony Taylor makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Crystal Palace. Let’s see what happens!
11' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
10' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) receives a defence-splitting pass from David Moller Wolfe and shoots early from the edge of the box, but his poor attempt goes well wide of the left post.
10' Andre (Wolves) plays a terrific long ball forward to Marshall Munetsi, but he can't beat his man and the move breaks down.
9' The free kick into the penalty area from Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) is cleared.
8' Andre (Wolves) jumps into a tackle and Anthony Taylor signals a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Crystal Palace.
6' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
5' Andre (Wolves) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
4' Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
3' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Sam Johnstone intercepts the ball.
2' Emmanuel Agbadou (Wolves) sends a long cross over to Jackson Tchatchoua, but Dean Henderson comes forward to gather the ball.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Wolves will have the kick-off.
Anthony Taylor is the one to supervise the game today.
